items.title: Whitmer Thomas – “Terminal Crew Of Dudes”
items.summary: "Well, how lucky can one guy be? I found some pals as dumb as me." That's the dream! It's also the opening line from the new Whitmer Thomas song "Terminal Crew Of Dudes." Alabama native Thomas is probably better-known as an actor and a comedian than as a musician.

items.title: Radiator Hospital – “Walk With Love”
items.summary: "Walk With Love," the latest song from Radiator Hospitals' Sam Cook-Parrott, doesn't mince words. The third single from his forthcoming studio album Distorting Time, following "A Fine Vintage" and "Wall Between Us," has a simple yet powerful message at its heart: "There's so much you can't control, but this choice is yours. Are you gonna walk with love?" The post Radiator Hospital – “Walk With Love” appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: heavensouls – “dawn of the city”
items.summary: Chidi Obialo is a 20-year-old Nigerian-born, Houston-based electronic producer who specializes in sample-collage tracks that never show the slightest adherence to any particular genre. He makes a whole lot of music, and he landed on my radar when my old friend Ryan Dombal profiled him for Hearing Things earlier this year.
